places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake Spoon rides in after ten years away, eats breakfast, pitches a Montana drive and admits a killing; Newt recalls Jake visiting his late mother here.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, reached by a stage road through mesquite and chaparral

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: Jake jokes they should have telegraphed ahead from there on their all-night ride in.
places.location_hint: on the route from San Antonio to Lonesome Dove, about twelve miles from Lonesome Dove; apparently has a telegraph

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Rumor once reached Newt that Jake was a lawman there.

places.name: Black Hills
places.note: Another rumor had Jake prospecting for gold there.

places.name: Alabama
places.note: Newt's grandfather, his mother Maggie's father, lived there.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Jake has ridden hard all the way from there, fleeing trouble.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Under three weeks ago Jake's stray buffalo-rifle shot killed the town's dentist-mayor, brother of Sheriff July Johnson; Jake fled.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Sheriff July Johnson was away there testifying against stage robbers when the shooting happened.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake praises its rich grass and urges a cattle drive there before others arrive, once the Indians are subdued.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Jake claims he saw huge buffalo herds beyond it while delivering beef to the Blackfeet.

places.name: Milk River
places.note: Jake says he went nearly to it, close enough to sense Canada.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Jake claims Canada felt near from northern Montana; his gunman reputation is known from Mexico to Canada.

places.name: Wichita country
places.note: Where Pea Eye once missed a wolf and his bullet killed Call's horse beyond a hill.
places.location_hint: around the Wichita River / Wichita Mountains area of north Texas and southwest Indian Territory

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at the outfit's house and lots; Dish, Pea and Newt digging the well

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: at the Hat Creek house, newly arrived from Arkansas
